author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finger control, lines that ask and answer, taking turns on the chorus and verse-and-chorus shape, using a cheerful banjo travelling song.

classes.title: Banjo hand on the keys
classes.goal: Hear the song, find C by the two black keys and place five fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys as a sign to find C

classes.parentPrompt: Strum a pretend banjo on your knee, then help your child rest the thumb on C.
classes.childAction: Strum your knee, then put your thumb on C and fingers beside it.
classes.bridge: C sits just left of the two black keys, where the journey starts.

intro.caption: Strum a banjo on your knee
intro.parentCue: strum along together as the song plays

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger number for each key

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding C and placing five fingers.

classes.title: Finger four takes a nap
classes.goal: Learn the first line, climbing with fingers one, two, three, then five.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting fingers in order, then skipping one

classes.parentPrompt: Gently tap finger four and say 'nap time'. You play the high A in 'Alabama'.
classes.childAction: Play 1, 2, 3, then hop to 5. Finger four rests.
classes.bridge: Step, step, step, then a hop over F, where finger four sleeps.

intro.caption: Finger four takes a nap
intro.parentCue: tap finger four gently and say nap time

games.caption: I came from: C, D, E, G

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing fingers in order and skipping one.

classes.title: Two lines, two endings
classes.goal: Learn the next lines and hear one end on D and the other land home on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two lines begin alike; only one ends at home

classes.parentPrompt: After each line, ask: 'Home yet?' Shrug for D, hug for C.
classes.childAction: Play each line; shrug on D, smile big on home C.
classes.bridge: D is a step before the door; C is home, where the journey rests.

intro.caption: Is the traveller home yet?
intro.parentCue: ask after each line; shrug or hug

games.caption: Banjo on my knee
games.parentCue: Shrug together on the last D

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing two lines that end differently.

classes.title: Oh, Susanna: you and me
classes.goal: Share the chorus call: the child plays F, the grown-up answers on high A.

mathTarget.parentLine: One player calls, the other answers, taking turns

classes.parentPrompt: After your child plays 'Oh, Su', you answer 'san-na' on the high A.
classes.childAction: Play F, F with finger four, then listen for the answer.
classes.bridge: Oh, Su-san-na: you call on F, your grown-up answers high on A.

intro.caption: You call, I answer
intro.parentCue: you play the high A answer each time

games.caption: Oh, Su: F, F
games.parentCue: Answer with A, A right after

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: taking turns, call and answer.

classes.title: Don't you cry, slide down
classes.goal: Learn the 'don't you cry' line, which slides down in skips: G, E, C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune goes down, skipping a key each time

classes.parentPrompt: Slide your hand down your child's arm in three hops as the tune goes down.
classes.childAction: Play G, G, E, C, then D, D: down the slide.
classes.bridge: Five, three, one: hop down the slide, skipping a step each time.

intro.caption: Down the slide we go
intro.parentCue: hop your hand down your child's arm

games.caption: Don't you cry for me
games.parentCue: Say five, five, three, one, two, two

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a tune skip downwards.

classes.title: I know this line!
classes.goal: Learn the last lines and recognise the banjo line from the start, coming back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing a line and knowing we met it before

classes.parentPrompt: Play the line first and ask: 'Have we heard this before?' Cheer when your child says yes.
classes.childAction: Listen, say 'I know this one!', then play it.
classes.bridge: The banjo line comes back like a friend waving at the end of the trip.

intro.caption: Have we heard this before?
intro.parentCue: let your child answer before they play

games.caption: With my banjo on my knee
games.parentCue: Sing the words softly as they play

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: recognising a line that comes back.

classes.title: Verse and chorus
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and hear the story part and the 'Oh, Susanna' part.

mathTarget.parentLine: A story part, then a singing-together part that repeats

classes.parentPrompt: Sit still for the verse; bounce together when the 'Oh, Susanna' chorus starts.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; bounce when the chorus comes.
classes.bridge: The verse is the road; the chorus is the happy song at each stop.

intro.caption: Story part, then chorus
intro.parentCue: bounce together when the chorus begins

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a verse and a chorus.

classes.title: Run-ning, walk
classes.goal: Practise the quick start, 'I came from', slowly: two quick notes, then a walk.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two quick notes fit in the time of one walking note

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'run-ning, walk' with the notes and clap it once before your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play C, D quickly, then E, like 'run-ning, walk'.
classes.bridge: Two quick steps fit into one walking step, like a skip on the road.

intro.caption: Run-ning, walk!
intro.parentCue: clap it once together before they play

games.caption: I came from: run-ning, walk
games.parentCue: Say run-ning, walk with the notes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: quick notes and walking notes.

classes.title: Banjo band play-along
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going to the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, all the way to the end

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the chorus loudly beside your child; if they miss a note, keep singing.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep going after a slip.
classes.bridge: You and the music walk the long road side by side.

intro.caption: Join the banjo band!
intro.parentCue: sing beside your child and keep going

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: Don't cry, teddy!
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy with a happy, bouncy sound.

mathTarget.parentLine: Choosing a happy, bouncy way to play

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play with bouncy fingers, then clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play a happy, bouncy song for teddy, then bow.
classes.bridge: Bouncy fingers sound like a banjo; the last C is the journey's end.

intro.caption: A happy song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a happy sound.
